title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30081: add VAT registration number override event
summary: An integration event allows extensions to override VAT registration number formatting in Intrastat reports before standard concatenation logic runs.
key_points: New OnBeforeGetVATRegNo integration event in GetVATRegNo of IntrastatReportManagement
Subscribers can return their own VAT registration number and set IsHandled to skip the standard concatenation
Lets extensions avoid invalid partner VAT IDs when the stored number already includes the country prefix
